content:
Join WhiteHart Casino and claim a 500% bonus up to €1,200 on your first deposit. We offer four welcome bonuses, daily cashback of up to 20%, a five-tier VIP Club and weekly tournaments with prize pools of up to €50,000.

Choose from 14,146 slots, 633 Live Games and titles from 74 game providers. Our website also features a Big Wins feed and an actual RTP leaderboard based on the last three days of gameplay. Enjoy these features at your own pace and keep responsible gaming in mind.

Welcome Bonuses & Promotions

WhiteHart offers a welcome package covering your first four deposits, with a combined maximum bonus value of €5,200.

Welcome bonuses can be used on slots from all providers. The maximum bet with bonus funds is €10 per round, while maximum winnings from a deposit bonus are capped at 20 times the deposit amount. Only one bonus can be active at a time.

We also offer a separate 50% Live Casino bonus up to €500. The maximum bet with bonus funds in this category is €25 per round. Full details are available in the relevant promotion.

You can cancel a bonus through our support team before placing your first bet, without losing your own funds. After your fourth deposit, you can access regular reload bonuses based on your VIP tier.

Tournaments

We run weekly tournaments with prize pools of up to €50,000, alongside separate competitions from game providers. These include Big Sunday Blast from Boongo and Playson, featuring a €25,000 prize pool every Sunday, and the Book of Billionaire series from Fugaso, with a €1,500,000 prize pool in its November edition.

Each event in our tournament lobby has its own card showing the name, prize pool, provider and Sign Up button. Active indicates an ongoing tournament, while Expired identifies a completed event. Entry requirements and prize distribution rules are available in each tournament's details.

Cashback

At WhiteHart Casino, cashback is credited daily at 16:00 based on real-money losses from the previous day. Your cashback rate depends on your VIP tier and ranges from 5% to 20%.

To qualify for cashback, you must have made a deposit the previous day, lost the deposited funds without using bonuses and made no withdrawal requests. Maximum winnings from cashback are capped at 25 times the cashback amount, subject to the daily limit for your tier.

VIP Club

Our VIP Club has five tiers, from Bronze to Diamond. Your status is determined by your total successful deposits and is updated after each deposit. Bonus funds and manual credits do not count towards your total.

From Sapphire onwards, we provide a dedicated VIP manager and personalised offers. Gold adds access to a private VIP WhatsApp group, document verification within 24 hours, surprise rewards and 24/7 priority support. Diamond members also receive a birthday gift.

Weekly no-deposit bonuses are available once per week, separately from the standard VIP bonuses. Maximum winnings from no-deposit offers depend on your tier: Bronze - 5 times the bonus amount, Silver - 10 times, Sapphire - 15 times, Gold - 20 times and Diamond - 30 times.

Fair Play & RTP

We calculate the actual RTP of games using betting and winning activity across our casino network over the last three days. Only games with at least 1,000 rounds played during this period qualify for the leaderboard.

Unlike the theoretical RTP set by a game developer, our figures reflect actual results over a shorter period. They change as new data becomes available and may occasionally exceed 100%. For example, Fisherman's Bounty Deluxe recorded 207.75%, Gonzo's Quest Megaways 185.54% and Coin Strike XXL Hold and Win 182.96% in the recorded leaderboard.

Our Fair Play & RTP section lets you explore games with the highest and lowest actual return percentages. These figures do not predict future outcomes or guarantee winnings. The theoretical RTP of each game can be found in the information published by its developer.

Casino Games

Our game library includes slots, table games, Live Casino and game shows. We feature titles from 74 providers, including Play'n GO, Yggdrasil, BGaming, Boongo and Playson.

The Slots section contains 14,146 games. Popular mechanics include Megaways with a variable number of winning combinations, Hold and Win with bonus symbols, Gigablox with larger reel blocks and Cash Collect features. Available titles include Book of Dead, Starburst, Gonzo's Quest Megaways and Gold Mine Express.

Live Games features 633 titles, covering roulette, blackjack, baccarat and live game shows. You can play Lightning Storm, MONOPOLY Big Baller, Galactic VIP Roulette, Blackjack VIP and Speed Baccarat. Individual tables offer different betting ranges and game speeds.

For quicker browsing, we have added Top Games with 38 titles and New Games with 14,820 listed titles. Our homepage also features a Big Wins feed displaying game names, player nicknames and recent winning amounts.

Registration & Login

To register at WhiteHart Casino, you need an email address, password and phone number. The Sign Up form also lets you select your country and account currency, with an optional Promo Code field. You must confirm that you are at least 18 years old and accept our terms before creating an account.

Use the Log In tab to access your account. During account verification, we may request additional proof of identity or personal details in line with our security requirements.

Payments & Withdrawals

At WhiteHart Casino, withdrawals are available via bank cards, bank transfers and cryptocurrencies. The minimum withdrawal amount is €100 per transaction. Weekly and monthly limits depend on your VIP tier.

VIP players may request higher limits, subject to approval from their dedicated manager. Requests exceeding the applicable limits may be declined, with the funds returned to the account balance.

Before your first withdrawal, we verify your identity and ownership of the payment method. Depending on your circumstances, we may request:

  • A passport, national ID card or driving licence, together with a selfie holding the document.

  • Proof of address dated within the last three months.

  • Proof of ownership of your bank card or account, with sensitive card details concealed.

  • Additional documents or phone verification where required.

Requested documents must be submitted within five working days. Once we have received and verified them, our finance team processes withdrawal requests within 1–2 working days. The subsequent transfer depends on the payment method and may take a further 3–10 working days. We send a confirmation once the withdrawal has been approved.

mainEntity.name: Can I activate multiple bonuses at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only one bonus can be active at a time, and switching between active bonuses is not supported.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel a bonus after claiming it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Contact our 24/7 support team before placing your first bet. Your own funds will remain in your account.

mainEntity.name: How does my VIP status change?

acceptedAnswer.text: We update your tier after each successful deposit. Only real-money deposits count towards your lifetime total.

mainEntity.name: Why does a game's RTP sometimes exceed 100%?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our figures reflect actual results over the last three days. If total winnings exceed total stakes during that period, the RTP can rise above 100%. This does not guarantee similar results in future rounds.

mainEntity.name: What if my withdrawal request exceeds my limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can submit a new request within your available limit. VIP players may also arrange an individual limit increase through their dedicated manager.

mainEntity.name: Can additional documents be requested after registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We may request proof of identity, address or payment method ownership when verifying your account or reviewing transactions.
